meta.title: Renoise Live: AI Survival Show Steered by Chat
meta.description: Renoise Live is an AI survival reality show: four castaways on a storm-bound island, with live chat deciding what they face next. Streams continuously.

h1: Renoise Live: the island where chat is the weather

faqs.a: A survival reality series airing as a continuous AI livestream: four contestants are stranded on a storm-bound island, and every scene reacts to what the live audience decides.

faqs.q: Can viewers actually decide what happens?
faqs.a: Yes — chat picks what the islanders encounter next, and the chosen scene is generated live. The show renders your decision and keeps the story flowing from there.

faqs.q: Does Renoise Live follow a script?
faqs.a: No pre-written episodes. The series generates scene by scene; the standing premise (castaways, island, storm) stays fixed while the audience's choices drive what actually happens.
